selection_rule: Among trained checkpoints with 32 real on-policy training shifts sampled under that exact Actor, minimize mean frozen joint cost; tie-break earlier update. No new 100-shift data used.

metric_definitions.grade_compliance: all four nonempty window grades in [.26,.28], epsilon 1e-12
metric_definitions.complete_task: all four windows compliant AND ore>=16000 AND waste>=4000
metric_definitions.rmse: sqrt(mean((G-.27)^2)) over nonempty windows with explicit empty count
metric_definitions.critic_before: pre-update frozen Critic on its following 32 on-policy training shifts
metric_definitions.critic_after: post-update Critic on same 32 training shifts; in-sample diagnostic, not policy rank

limitations: Each candidate uses different environment and Actor sampling seeds; 32-shift means are noisy and not paired.
Training selection has selection optimism; the new 100 shifts are held out and cannot change selection.
Update 16 has no follow-up physical collection; its training_summary cost does not measure update 16.
Critic MSE/EV do not measure Actor business performance and are not ranking criteria.
Only one model initialization seed; no multi-seed stability claim.
